High priest is an office of the [[Melchizedek Priesthood]]. It is considered a prerequisite to being a [[Bishop (Latter Day Saints)|bishop]] or a [[Patriarchal Priesthood|Patriarch]].

One must be initiated as an [[Elder (Latter Day Saints)|elder]] before becoming a high priest.
